description.value: The Sugar Shack is a Quebec-inspired restaurant and maple specialty store on Highway 97 at 70 Mile House in the South Cariboo, widely known for its authentic poutine made with fresh-cut fries, peppercorn gravy, and curd cheese. The menu also features full breakfasts daily, tourtière, Montreal smoked meat sandwiches, and a full line of house-made maple products sourced directly from Quebec. It has developed a strong reputation as a destination stop for travellers along Highway 97, drawing visitors from across North America and beyond.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully fetched and confirms an active Quebec-inspired restaurant and maple shop on Highway 97 in 70 Mile House, BC (South Cariboo). The OSM address lacks city/town, which the website supplies. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears anywhere in the website content, so those remain null. The community field in OSM ('Unknown / Okanagan & Thompson') is geographically incorrect — 70 Mile House is in the Cariboo region, not the Okanagan & Thompson.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Unknown / Okanagan & Thompson' but the business is in 70 Mile House, which is in the South Cariboo region — incorrect regional categorization.
OSM address ('2481 Willow Drive') lacks city/province; city derived from website ('70 Mile House, BC') and added to address field.
No phone number in OSM; two phone numbers found on website (Brenda: 250-572-4259, Robert: 604-698-2805). Used Brenda's number as primary listing contact.
Bike parking, washrooms, and water refill are unverifiable from available evidence — on-site visit recommended to complete required criteria.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating restaurant on a major touring corridor (Highway 97) with strong traveller reviews cited on-site; a natural rest stop for cyclists riding the South Cariboo.
enrichment_extras.notes: Online ordering is available for packaged maple products via the website shop. The About page mentions a memorial food truck (Maryse's) that the owners intend to relaunch — verify on a future visit whether a separate food truck operation exists.
